offering_description.value: Ferguson distributes plumbing, HVAC, waterworks and industrial supplies to contractors, builders, utilities, facilities operators and homeowners. It sources products from manufacturers and fills orders through branches, showrooms, distribution centers and online stores.

primary_products.value: plumbing fixtures and supplies; water and sewer infrastructure products; HVAC equipment and parts; industrial pipe, valves and fittings; appliances and lighting

primary_services.value: pipe fabrication; jobsite logistics; inventory management; project planning and product selection

customer_segment.value: B2B: plumbing and HVAC contractors, homebuilders, commercial builders, industrial facilities and private utilities; B2G: municipal water and sewer utilities and public works departments; B2C: homeowners buying fixtures, appliances and lighting for home projects

end_markets.value: residential construction and remodeling; commercial construction and building maintenance; water and wastewater infrastructure; industrial facilities; home improvement

revenue_model.value: product sales: building systems equipment, fixtures, parts and infrastructure supplies sold to trade and retail buyers

value_chain_position.value: distributor: sources and stocks manufacturer products for contractors, builders, utilities and industrial customers; retailer: sells sourced fixtures, appliances and lighting to homeowners through showrooms and online stores; service provider: fabricates pipe assemblies from stock and manages inventory and jobsite deliveries for contractors and facilities

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: plumbing, waterworks, HVAC, industrial piping, fire protection, and kitchen and bath products

distribution_channels.value: own locations: trade branches, supply counters and kitchen and bath showrooms; direct sales: sales teams serving contractors, builders, utilities and industrial accounts; online: trade ordering portals and consumer home improvement websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: OSHA warehouse safety, federal motor carrier rules for delivery fleets, and lead-free standards for drinking-water products

notes: It is unclear which fabrication and logistics services are billed separately.
